messages:
maya: FYI customer (ACME EU) flagged invoice where one line shows -€0.01 'rounding adj' and invoice total doesn't match dashboard usage. Ticket #CS-9987
jordan: link to invoice? /cc @li
maya: https://invoices.redwood/acme/INV-2026-0005
maya: They claim dashboard usage (tokens) => billed amount differs by €0.12. Customer is on multi-currency EUR billing; some requests in USD via gateway.
li: that's likely per-request rounding being applied before aggregation. Did we previously switch to per-request rounding for currency conversion? @jordan any policy changes last week?
jordan: we shipped a small change to line-item formatting (ENG-5410) — shouldn't affect sums but maybe rounding logic changed. Will check commit.
li: repro steps I ran:
```
POST /v1/usage/report
{ "customer":"acme","requests": [ {"id":1,"currency":"EUR","amount_micros":125678 }, {"id":2,"currency":"USD","amount_micros":-2000 } ] }
```
aggregate -> convert USD->EUR by rate 0.92 -> convert micros -> rounding to cents per request -> sum -> yields -1 cent phantom.
maya: customer provided CSV of per-request billed cents, shows one -1 cent line labeled 'FX rounding'
tom: customer is seeing negative balance applied to next invoice. They're unhappy.
jordan: I dug into ENG-5410: we introduced per-line rounding to 2 decimals instead of aggregating micros. That will create small discrepancies. I can revert but need to ensure tax calc still works.
li: proposal: change pipeline to aggregate in micros (int64) per-currency, apply tax and FX at aggregation boundary, then round once per invoice line. Also add a reconciliation check that flags >€0.05 differences.
maya: can we hotfix invoice formatting for ACME so next invoice doesn't show negative line? Customer requested temporary credit.
jordan: I'll open an ops hotpatch: rollback ENG-5410 for invoice generation, mark ACME invoice to be regenerated. Creating internal ticket BILL-307.
li: I'll add unit tests + backfill script to recompute invoices for affected customers.
maya: cc @tom advising customer. Thanks everyone :pray:
billing-bot: Ticket BILL-307 created by jordan — priority: high — assignee: billing-team
maya: I'll reply to customer with ETA 48h and offer provisional credit. End thread.
